description.content:
Retrieve the account takeover sensitivity settings for the specified company.

Sensitivity Options:
  • 1 (Aggressive): Most sensitive - requires fewer alerts to trigger an incident
  • 2 (Balanced): Default sensitivity level
  • 3 (Relaxed): Least sensitive - requires more alerts to trigger an incident

Scopes:
  • company.all
  • company.view

response.name: Successful response containing account takeover sensitivity settings.
